title: attacks.json
description: One entry per attack, its log, the rows it reaches, and its `moved`.

log.description: The attacked log's path under the data directory.

first.description: The first row the attack reaches, counted over every row of the test set.

last.description: The last row the attack reaches, counted the same way.

moved.description: How far the attack took a row from the row the bus really produced, the largest over the rows it changed, in train set std.
